result:
I fixed one blocked run this hour and changed no tuning, because the 32-core CPU cap is still the limit.

**Running now:** 6 FEBio runs on 34 pinned cores with no overlap: 5 mu03 window restarts and ASTM p064 compression (4.9 h so far). They use 27.9 of the 32 allowed cores and are throttled for 11 s in every 10 s.
- **Memory:** 17.6 GB in real use out of 137 GB; the rest is file cache. No new out-of-memory kills (still 2 in total). /raid has 2.2 TB free.
- **GPUs:**
  - GPU 0: 4.8 GB, all mine.
  - GPU 1: 1.7 GB, another user's.
  - GPU 2: mine 3.2 GB, another user 16.9 GB.
  - GPU 3: mine 2.9 GB, another user 4.0 GB.
  - GPU 4: 2.2 GB, mine.
  - GPUs 5 and 6: full, another user's.

**Queues:**
- **h19 FEBio queue:** empty (0 waiting, 0 running, 2680 done, 2 failed).
- **h51 windows:** about 30 waiting on 19 workers, held by the 32-core rule and busy GPUs.
- **evo task queue:** empty; the 5 failed tasks are old (10-28).
- **Last hour:** 22 windows ended, 12 normally and 10 with solver errors (negative Jacobian). cyc3vpen p062 flexion ended with an error at t 9.397 after 69.7 core-hours.

**Action taken:** the mu06 p062 run the PI asked for on 11-20 (friction 0.6 upper bound) was blocked.
- **Cause:** someone edited `current_settings.json` at 22:46, after the case was built at 22:19. That made its h24 preflight stale, so the 06:40 launch was refused, and it would have been refused again each time GPU 4 freed up.
- **Fix:** I ran the full h24 preflight check on it, which rebuilds the case against the current settings, so nothing was bypassed. It passed with no errors or warnings and will start when GPU 4 and a core slot are free.
- **Others:** the other 14 waiting cases have valid preflights.

**Services:** every live lane in `resume_all.sh` is up. The sessions that aren't running all have their finished markers, so a restart won't relaunch finished work.

**Needs a person:**
- **Scientist:** 5 of the error windows failed 1–2 minutes after restart, at t 3.54–3.60 (mu03r p026 extension, p117 flexion and extension, p125 flexion; mu03Gr p095 extension). Is that expected?
- **Scientist:** rerun or accept cyc3vpen p062 flexion; cyc3vdt p062/p124 flexion is also still undecided.
- **Person:** commit `ops/resume_all.sh`, `ops/astm_lanes.sh` and `ops/push_lanes.sh`.
- **Process:** any edit to `current_settings.json` makes every built case that hasn't started yet stale. Whoever edits it should re-run the preflight check on the waiting window cases.

The report is in `work/agents/foreman/report_20261121_0735.md`; `status.json` and `work/ops/foreman_actions.log` are updated. I also saved a memory note about the settings-edit problem.

The Google Drive connector needs authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings; it can't be used until then.
